headline: Cyle Larin secures Canada's first World Cup point in 1-1 draw vs Bosnia
summary: The World Cup co-hosts avoided defeat for the first time in their history after a late equalizer from Larin in their Group B opener.
details: Canada secured a historic 1-1 draw against Bosnia and Herzegovina in their Group B opener on Friday, marking the first time the nation has avoided defeat in a World Cup match.
caption:
History made! Canada earns its first-ever World Cup point after a dramatic late equalizer.

Canada secured a historic 1-1 draw against Bosnia and Herzegovina in their Group B opener on Friday, marking the first time the nation has avoided defeat in a World Cup match.

headline_marked: Bangladeshi musician [[Sanjay represents country]] at World Cup opening
headline: Bangladeshi musician Sanjay represents country at World Cup opening
summary: Sanjay showcased Bangladesh's identity through a custom jacket featuring a Royal Bengal Tiger and the national flag on the global stage.
details: Bangladeshi musician Sanjay performed at the World Cup opening ceremony in Canada, sharing the stage with international stars Nora Fatehi and Veggie Dreams.
The musician caught attention by wearing a custom jacket with intricate embroidery of a Royal Bengal Tiger and the Bangladeshi flag on the sleeves.
During his performance, Sanjay pointed to the embroidery on his sleeves to highlight and promote his national identity to the global audience.
The performance is being hailed as a unique example of using fashion to represent one's country during a major global event.
Sanjay, who hails from Sylhet, demonstrated significant confidence and pride in showcasing Bangladesh on such a high-profile international platform.
caption:
A Royal Bengal Tiger on the world stage! 🇧🇩

Bangladeshi musician Sanjay performed at the World Cup opening ceremony in Canada, sharing the stage with international stars Nora Fatehi and Veggie Dreams.

The musician caught attention by wearing a custom jacket with intricate embroidery of a Royal Bengal Tiger and the Bangladeshi flag on the sleeves.

During his performance, Sanjay pointed to the embroidery on his sleeves to highlight and promote his national identity to the global audience.

The performance is being hailed as a unique example of using fashion to represent one's country during a major global event.

Sanjay, who hails from Sylhet, demonstrated significant confidence and pride in showcasing Bangladesh on such a high-profile international platform.

#Bangladesh #WorldCup #Sanjay #GlobalStage #Pride #Music

Source: Prothom Alo, Somoy News
